caveats: The event index (`support_events[17]`) cannot be resolved from the data export alone — event ordering lives in code, which this investigation is forbidden to read. The identification rests on: (a) the scenario names Bloodsong, (b) Bloodsong is the roster's support-slot item, (c) 1.5 s is the unique support-roster cooldown equal to the new value, and (d) Black Cleaver contributes no cooldown.

One way the new value could still be wrong: if `support_events[17]` were in fact the Celestial Opposition event, 1.5 would be a mis-extraction of that item's *slow duration* ({{fd|1.5}} seconds) in place of its true 18-second cooldown, since both numbers appear in one sentence. Nothing in the cached data supports that reading for a Bloodsong-named scenario, and it would require the leaf to belong to an item absent from the scenario title, so it is recorded as a residual risk rather than a finding.
verdict_rationale: The Bloodsong `Spellblade` internal cooldown is stated verbatim as 1.5 seconds in the cached wiki text and is corroborated by the identical constant across all seven Spellblade-group items. The prior `<absent>` reflected the parser leaving `passives[0].cooldown` null rather than a genuine lack of cooldown, so surfacing 1.5 is a correction; 1.5 s raw (no haste adjustment) is the right recorded value.
